info.title: Jobicy Universal API

parameters.description: Optional Jobicy category slug such as engineering, devops, supporting, marketing, or finance.

parameters.description: Optional keyword to search across job title and description.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

jobIndustry.description: Jobicy job categories attached to the listing.

jobSlug.description: Jobicy slug for the job listing.

jobType.description: Job type labels such as Full-Time or Contract.

salaryCurrency.description: ISO 4217 salary currency code when available.

salaryMax.description: Maximum salary when Jobicy provides it.

salaryMin.description: Minimum salary when Jobicy provides it.

salaryPeriod.description: Salary period when available, such as yearly.
